title.narrative: Strengthening Political Institutions Kenya 2019-2022 - Strengthening Political Institutions

description.narrative: Oslocentret har inkommit med en ansökan om 15 MSEK för att stödja ett projekt med syfte att stärka de politiska institutionerna för att de ska bli mer lyhörda, ansvarstagande och transparenta i hela valcykeln. Ambassadens samarbetspartner ska stödja sex politiska partier, samt partiregistraren genom dialog, utbildning, framtagande av riktlinjer och andra viktiga dokument. Projektet ska stödja partierna till att utveckla välfungerande partikommittéer på länsnivå, för att kunna bli mer effektiva i att tillvarata medborgarnas intressen och kunna föra en partilinje i länsregeringarna. Skulle den potentiella grundlagsomröstningen bli av är man beredd att inkludera förberedelser inom sina projektpartners för att medborgarnas intressen ska tillvaratas i den processen.

The Oslo Center has submitted a proposal of 15 MSEK to support a project aiming to strengthen political institutions to enhance responsiveness, accountability and transparency in the electorral cycle. The Embassy cooperation partner will work with six political parties, as well as the Office of the Registrar of Political Parties through dialogues, trainings, development of guidelines and other important documents. The project shall support the parties to develop well functioning political party committess in the counties, to enhance efficiency and becoming more responsive to the interests of the citizens, and to speak with 'one party voice' in the county governments.The project is prepared to include preparations of their partners to include the interests of the citizens in the constitutional referendum process, should it be carried out.

The overarching program goal was:
Strengthening Political Institutions to Enhance Responsiveness, Accountability, and Transparency in the Electoral Cycle
The four outcome areas were:
i) County Assembly political parties groups become responsive to the needs of citizens ii) Political parties have operationalised their party constitution in a more accountable and transparent manner iii) To strengthen the office of the Registrar of Political parties (ORPP) to better perform its roles and responsibilities, and iv) Strengthening Women Participation in Political parties' processes and decision making (added in an agreement amendment in December 2019)
